sources.title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for ...
sources.snippet: Deep Principle has released Hydrogen-1.0, an open-weight scientific model for chemistry, materials science and life sciences. It is built by post-training Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 on domain data, laboratory records and agent discovery trajectories. For developers, it offers open weights that report a FrontierScience-Research win over GPT-6-Astra.
